The bundled Wall fonts (Orbitron, Bebas Neue, Russo One, Rajdhani, Chakra Petch) are from Google Fonts and are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). They are served from this site, unmodified (WOFF2 latin subsets), so no font is ever loaded from a third-party host at runtime.
Added 2026-10-18 (desktop Text redesign, Phase 2): Cinzel Decorative, UnifrakturCook, Pirata One, Eagle Lake, Metal Mania, Great Vibes, Alex Brush, Pinyon Script, Italianno, Tangerine and Ballet.
All eleven are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (verified against https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl, METADATA.pb "license: OFL"), distributed as the
official Google Fonts WOFF2 latin subsets, unmodified, and served from this site. Their copyright notices, Reserved Font Names and the full licence text are in OFL-NOTICES.txt.
The font files are not sold on their own, and users cannot upload fonts: the library is curated by GamID.
The remaining catalog entries are system font stacks: no font file is shipped or fetched for them.
Adding a bundled font requires its licence to be recorded here first.
